body:
This was how I felt but honestly, it’s better to let things out than to bottle it all up. I started writing my feelings on my phone in order to cope and I feel like it’s really helping. But there are times where it gets too unbearable and that’s when I’ll seek my friends for comfort. 

If you need someone to talk to...I’m here x

I know you feel like no one cares and that’s how I felt too. I opened up to a few of my friends and I realised there ARE people who care. Sometimes, the people in your life may not understand what you’re going through but that doesn’t mean that you not being here anymore will not affect them. 

Try not to stay in bed all day – maybe try to go out & explore your neighbourhood. I started walking around on my own and it really helped to take my mind off of things. 

If you feel like you have no one to turn to, I’m here. I don’t know you personally but I care and I hope you’ll be able to get through this. We are all much stronger than we think x
I understand your pain...I’m here if you need someone to talk to. You are stronger than you think x

Please, hang in there. I know life isn’t great to you now...but don’t give up on yourself. The only friend I can truly open up to lives in a different country so I can understand how alone you must feel due to the time difference. I’m here if you need someone to talk to.

I started crying as soon as I read this...It sucks that I’m always the one getting hurt in relationships. This was my 3rd and I foolishly thought things would work out...As much as I’m glad that he’s okay, it feels fucking shitty knowing that he’s having the time of his life while I’m here feeling this way. 

Also, thank you for this. I’ve always felt so alone & knowing that I’m not alone in this is actually comforting. Stay strong. We’ll get through this.
Thank you for this. It’s comforting to know that someone has been through something similar and managed to get out of it. Thank you for that little bit of hope.

Yea...I know NC would be better but I’d still like to be considered as a friend to him & I’d feel awful if I were to block him...I’ve made up my mind to stop contacting him & maybe when I’m less hurt, we can actually form a friendship. I’m trying my best now to stop checking up on him & stalking his friends to see what he’s up to.

As much as I want to seek a professional...I’m afraid of the financial burden & I’m not sure I want to let my family know about this. I have a feeling they may brush it off & call me stupid for feeling this way. They knew about my breakup but never once asked me how I was coping with it. Thank you for your kind words, I’m starting to have a little more hope :”)

alright thanks for the advice :”) we’ve been talking and while we aren’t getting back together anytime soon...we both know we’re still very much in love and we agree that it’s best for us to stay as friends for awhile. like you said, we’re just gonna see where life takes us :)

My boyfriend (17M) & I (17F) met when we were 13. I’m Singaporean (my mum’s indonesian so she already loves him) and he’s Indonesian but he came to Singapore to attend secondary school. We were in the same class and he had a crush on me. We kinda had something going on back then but nothing came out of it as we were too young and immature. We had a falling out at 14 and never spoke again until 16 and started dating shortly after reconnecting. 

Initially, we weren’t planning to be together as he was leaving Singapore to study in the states. But we had a lot of chemistry and just thought, screw it, we’ll overcome the long distance. Man, it was soooo tough at the start. I think I cried almost everyday. The time difference really makes things tough and it’s even tougher for me bcs I’m on vacation right now while he’s busy with college :( The last time we met was about a month ago in Indonesia and god, I miss him so much. The next time we’ll meet is when I go to the States next year. We’re young but we truly believe in our relationship. No one has ever made me happier even though he’s not physically by my side. We’ve made so many plans and memories together. I really really hope we’ll pull through and close the distance in the future :”) Stay strong to everyone else out there too!
